primaryWitnesses.text: The sons of Ham: Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.
primaryWitnesses.previousContext: The sons of Javan: Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, and Rodanim.
primaryWitnesses.nextContext: The sons of Cush: Seba, Havilah, Sabta, Raama, Sabteca. The sons of Raamah: Sheba and Dedan.
primaryWitnesses.decisionJa: ハムの子らとして挙がる個人カナンで、地名ではない。

primaryWitnesses.text: Canaan became the father of Sidon his firstborn, Heth,
primaryWitnesses.previousContext: Pathrusim, Casluhim (where the Philistines came from), and Caphtorim.
primaryWitnesses.nextContext: the Jebusite, the Amorite, the Girgashite,
primaryWitnesses.decisionJa: シドンとヘトの父となる系譜上の個人カナン。

primaryWitnesses.text: The sons of Judah: Er, Onan, and Shelah, which three were born to him of Shua’s daughter the Canaanitess. Er, Judah’s firstborn, was wicked in the LORD’s sight; and he killed him.
primaryWitnesses.previousContext: Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.
primaryWitnesses.nextContext: Tamar his daughter-in-law bore him Perez and Zerah. All the sons of Judah were five.
primaryWitnesses.decisionJa: 「カナン人の女」という民族・出自の形容で、地名の直接用例ではない。

primaryWitnesses.text: saying, “I will give you the land of Canaan, The lot of your inheritance,”
primaryWitnesses.previousContext: He confirmed it to Jacob for a statute, and to Israel for an everlasting covenant,
primaryWitnesses.nextContext: when you were but a few men in number, yes, very few, and foreigners in it.
primaryWitnesses.decisionJa: 「カナンの地」を嗣業の土地として明記する。
